carousel.title: Stand Out
carousel.body: Want to increase your chances of getting hired for a remote job? It starts with your application.

carousel.title: Lead with the Role
carousel.body: Open with the exact job title and where you saw it. Then say in one sentence why your recent work fits what the team does.

carousel.title: Show Async Work
carousel.body: Mention a project you ran with written updates, a shared document you owned, or a time zone gap you handled well.

carousel.title: Match Their Words
carousel.body: Read the job post twice and use the same words they use. It helps hiring software and tired humans find your fit.
